metadata.title: बांस पर टिकी आदिवासी जिंदगी | World Bamboo Day| Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description:
Every year “World Bamboo Day “is celebrate on 18 September to raise awareness about bamboo worldwide. Bamboo grows quickly and requires minimal water and pesticide and it can be harvested without harming the plant’s root system.

Bamboos are significant in Indian tribal society. They use bamboo in their day-to-day activities. Tribals makes handcrafted bag, carry bags for store paddy and fish traps. Bamboo shoots are also used to prepare delicious tribal food.
